evidence.quote: Several open problems of subpositive definite matrices and some inequalities. *(Chinese. English summary)*

Let A be a real square matrix. A is called subpositive definite if the symmetric part of A (i.e. (A+A^T)/2) is positive definite. The author proves some matrix inequalities involving subpositive definite matrices.
